Headline: #78 Montrose buses Temporary Westbound Reroute near Broadway/Wilson
ShortDescription: WB #78 Montrose buses are temporarily rerouted via Montrose, Broadway, Lawrence, Clark, Montrose & over regular route, due to construction near Broadway/Wilson.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Westbound #78 Montrose buses are temporarily rerouted via Montrose, Broadway, Lawrence, Clark, Montrose and over regular route, due to construction near Broadway/Wilson.

Eastbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Blue Line Delays
ShortDescription: Blue Line trains are running w/residual delays following an earlier minor fire at the track level near Harlem (FP). Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Blue Line trains are running with residual delays following an earlier minor fire at the track level near Harlem (Forest Park Branch).

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Allow extra travel time.
